title: ShouldRevalidateFunctionArgs
summary: URLs, reason, and mutation details used to decide whether to reload.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body: Aliases RevalidationArgs. Contains url, currentUrl, nextUrl, defaultShouldRevalidate, and reason (manual, action, or navigation). Action-triggered refreshes can also supply formMethod, formAction, formData, and actionResult.

sections.title: Usage and limits
sections.body: Return false to skip the selected loader. During manual or action revalidation, the current and next URLs describe the route being refreshed. Selecting route IDs limits the candidates first; shouldRevalidate then decides whether each candidate actually reloads.
